description: BENE.BIZ Power Slider visual lets you build interactive numeric and date range sliders for Power BI reports — a highly customizable way to filter data with precision and style. Configure horizontal or vertical sliders, choose from multiple filter types, add numeric input fields, and fine‑tune handle behavior, colors, tooltips, and spacing. Looking for a modern, flexible slider for your Power BI reports? The BENE.BIZ Power Slider delivers an intuitive filtering experience with extensive styling controls — all while remaining highly customizable to match your report's look and feel. Free features You can use the BENE.BIZ Power Slider for free with the following features: Numeric input fields — Show or hide input fields alongside the slider, with row orientation and left alignment. Input styling — Configure background color, font color, font size, font family, width, height, border color, border stroke, and stroke width. Reset button — Add a reset button to clear the current slider selection. Horizontal slider — Display the slider in horizontal orientation. Filter types — Choose from Between, Less than or equal to, and Greater than or equal to filter modes. Handle behaviour — Use the Tap interaction mode for moving slider handles.
